title: Wendell and the Vector
author: Casper Kavanagh
blurb: Yara Quintana, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
